name: text-comic-pop
title: Comic Pop
description: Chữ kiểu truyện tranh: nét đậm viền đen, bóng cứng, ruột vàng chấm halftone trên nền sao nổ, bật vào hơi nghiêng rồi đứng thẳng.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Magic UI (MIT); a faithful port is in the Magic UI collection

moworks.notes: Weight-900 word, dark outline (CSS stroke 3 px; demo 6 px), hard dark shadow 3.5–4 px, fill yellow #f2c84b with accent halftone dots on an 8 px grid (demo dots 0.5 → 3.1 px toward the bottom, rows offset 4 px); behind it a 16-point burst star (inner 80 %) in a card tone. Pop: opacity 0 → 1, scale 0.8 → 1, rotate −2° → 0, 0.6 s back.out (cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)); burst turns −6° → 0. Exit: scale 0.85 + fade 2.35–2.65 s; loop 2.8 s. Params: duration (0.6 s) · scale đầu (0.8) · rotate (−2°) · dots: lưới chấm halftone (8 px) · burst: sao nổ phía sau (bật). The look is CSS: weight-900 text, a thick dark outline and hard shadow (a copy behind), a yellow fill with accent halftone dots (background-clip: text).
